registered.title: Check or refuse the signature of an extern declaration no route calls
registered.why: Found by W48-QR-SCALAR-TYPES-R2 while closing W48-SEQUENTIAL-UNCHECKED-PARAMETER-TYPES: an `extern fn` declaration that no body calls is admitted on the sequential route with its parameter and result annotations unread (`extern fn f(x: Widget) -> Widget; fn main() -> i32 { return 0; }` checks). The extern routes (G02d, G02i) read every declaration they call and refuse any helper function at Q026; an uncalled declaration on another route is read by nothing but name resolution. Two tracked probes rely on it: docs/reports/remaining-v04/probes/P08-valid-named-use.qr and P10-decl-after-use-site.qr declare `extern fn f(q: quant<n where n := 5>) -> unit;` to show quantity-name resolution, so refusing unread declarations would move both (admission to refusal) and change what those frozen probes measure. Size: a declaration check on the sequential route (and any other route admitting an uncalled declaration) against the C04.1 ABI vocabulary or the quantity forms name resolution already reads; 2 fixtures move. DISCHARGE: every admitted extern declaration's annotations are read by the admitting route or refused, with P08/P10 attributed.

registered.title: Let a match arm on the typed error continue after the match
registered.why: W48-QR-SCALAR-TYPES-R2's `match CALL { Result::Ok … Result::Err … }` on source.scalar-calls.v1 is always the last thing its block does: each arm ends in `return`, `raise` or another `match`, so a function body is a tree and no join is modeled. The task profile's arms may continue with outer identities; a scalar arm that falls through (binding a fallback value and continuing) is refused by the grammar. Size: a join of the two arms' local slots in the scalar IR, the checker and the closed evaluator (scalar_calls.rs), C emission of the continuation after an if/else (scalar_calls_c_emit.rs), the parser's block end (source_scalar_calls.rs), Lean for the join; 0 fixtures move. DISCHARGE: an arm that ends without a terminator continues after the match with only outer bindings in scope, checked, evaluated and emitted, with native runs.

registered.title: Let a handler inspect which ArithmeticError variant it caught
registered.why: W48-QR-SCALAR-TYPES-R2's `Result::Err { error: e }` arm can only re-raise `e` (`raise e;`) or discard it: there is no match on the variant and no rendering of an error, so a program cannot tell Overflow from DivisionByZero from OutOfRange except by propagating it out of the entry (exit 80 + tag). Size: a variant pattern or an error-to-scalar conversion on the scalar route, its evaluation and emission (the C tag is already an int), a std.fmt rendering if one is wanted; 0 fixtures move. DISCHARGE: a handler that branches on or renders the variant, checked, evaluated and emitted, with Lean parity and native runs.
